name: Flute Ross Loria
original_name: フラウト・ロス・ロリア
source:
The leader of Em Pheyna, the town of the Teru Tribe. He follows and protects the Oath of Elemia. Flute respects Tastiella, who is very knowledgeable, and will go to her for advice for any significant event.

Although the Teru are allied friends with the Apostles of Elemia, it has been a long time since they have communicated. They no longer know of each others' situation or existence. They assume that no unusual events is good, and live their lives peacefully.

[Edited from [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/artonelico/]Ar Tonelico Official Site[/url]]
